entities.summary: Anne Kathryn Schleper is an American ice hockey player who plays for the Buffalo Beauts in the National Women's Hockey League (NWHL). She played collegiate hockey with the Minnesota Golden Gophers women's ice hockey team and earned her first appearance with the United States women's national ice hockey team at the 2011 IIHF Women's World Championship. Schleper is a native of St. Cloud, Minnesota.
